description:
This Source Sought Notice is issued solely for information and planning purposes and   shall not be   misconstrued as a Request for Quote (RFQ) nor does it constitute a commitment to the Government. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary; the Government will not pay for information requested nor will it compensate any respondent for any cost incurred in developing information provided to the Government. Not responding to this request for information does not preclude participation in any future RFQ, if any is issued. 

 The U.S. Army Contracting Command – Rock Island at Fort Dix is seeking potential sources for a Grounds Maintenance Services for the 99th Readiness Division facility in Curtis Bay, MD. Additional details of this requirement can be found in the Draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) and facility map. 

  Responses should address the following items:  

  (1) Please indicate which NAICS code is the most appropriate for procuring cleaning, inspection and all other aspects of the draft PWS. In your response, please address NAICS Codes: 561730 “Landscaping Services” with a size standard of $9.5 million. 

 (2) Address any concerns or unclear information within the draft PWS and/or facility map. 

 (3) Provide a capability statement for the particulars of this effort, with appropriate documentation supporting claims of organizational and staff capability. 

  (4) What type of work has your company performed in the past in support of the same or similar requirements? 

 (5) Does your organization plan to utilize subcontracting or teaming arrangements in order to perform the tasks of this requirement? If so, what percentage of the work do you anticipate performing? 

 (6) Provide your organization’s name, address, email address, Website address, phone number and a point of contact to reach. 

 (7) Provide a statement including current small/large business including socioeconomic status (8a, SDB, HubZone, etc.) Under NAICS Code 561730 and company profile to (office location(s), CAGE Code, UEI number, etc.). Responses to this RFI will be submitted by email directly to Contract Specialist, Nancy M. Zeng at Nancy.m.zeng.civ@army.mil. 

 THIS IS A FOLLOW-ON REQUIREMENT, NOT NEW REQUIREMENT. Previous Contract No. W15QKN-25-P-A170 and No Incumbent contractor currently provide service at this location. NO MORE QUESTIONS REGARDING THE CURRENT CONTRACT AND INCUMBENT CONTRACTOR WOULD BE ANSWERED BY REQUIRING ACTIVITY. 

   The requirement Draft Performance Work Statement and site map are attached for reference.
